claim_groups.facts: Akshaya entered films as playback singer in Maa under Bhubaneswar Mishra, then composed Malajanha in1965.
claim_groups.safe_wording: His film career began as a playback singer in Maa in the late1950s; Malajanha brought him into film music direction in1965.
claim_groups.limit: Do not silently resolve1958/1959 by choosing one. Maa original credits/advertisement not inspected.

claim_groups.facts: 2011 return-screening report identifies Akshaya as producer, music director and singer; Pranab Patnaik recalled hearing songs he had sung; Binodini Debi was honoured as lyricist.
claim_groups.angle: A literary adaptation was an ensemble of writing, voices and production, not one musician working alone.

claim_groups.facts: Saregama identifies Jajabara1975, composer Akshay Mohanty; Hai Se Harini Akhi by Pranab Kishore Patnaik; Danei Das Kahere Bhai by Akshay Mohanty and Geeta Patnaik; Gadi Chale Pachhei by Akshay Mohanty and Trupti Das.
claim_groups.limit: No lyricist attribution or sonic analysis from this page; catalogue read, recordings not listened to.

claim_groups.facts: MeraGana entry39324 lists Aei Bhara Janha Rati, Adina Megha1970: singers Akshaya Mohanty and Nirmala Mishra, composer Balakrushna Das, lyricist Narayan Prasad Singh.
claim_groups.angle: Useful distinction: Akshaya the singer also interpreted another composer’s music.
claim_groups.limit: Secondary catalogue credits; prefer phrasing pairing confidently, full credit tuple as catalogue attribution until original sleeve corroborated.

claim_groups.facts: Devdas explains Akshaya valued words and their ability to carry wit and repartee. He recalls Ghalib beside Akshaya’s bed and buying his own copy at Cuttack railway station.
claim_groups.angle: An intimate reading connection without inventing a visit or conversation scene.

claim_groups.facts: Devdas explains live audience responses could encourage emphasis, repetition and a conversational delivery; AIR sessions lacked that immediate audience.
claim_groups.limit: His explanation of a difference, not independently measured universal change; do not claim we heard the comparison.

claim_groups.facts: Devdas says the collaborators shared ideas but wrote privately with distinct authorial identities.
claim_groups.angle: Keep lyricist and composer credit separate; partnership did not erase either writer.

claim_groups.facts: Shyamanuja Das documents Ei Katha Rahila1962, Geeti1968 and Madhushala2001, edited by Renubala Mishra; posthumous Gitakhata predominantly film lyrics.
claim_groups.limit: No current in-print claim; no full-book reading. Retain authorial published-work dimension without exhaustive bibliography.

claim_groups.facts: Das describes Kalankita Nayaka1984 HMV/EMI album as four pieces written, composed and sung by Akshaya, while discussing differences in formal ghazal construction.
claim_groups.limit: Avoid categorical first-Odia-ghazal claim. This source contains research and stylistic interpretation, not original label image verification.

claim_groups.facts: 2016 Prasar Bharati archive announcement describes Punyara Nadi Tire,35 Akashvani Cuttack recordings spanning four decades.
claim_groups.angle: A bridge from cinema celebrity to radio work and preservation, without equating all songs with film tracks.

optional_source.facts: Interviewee remembers accompanying Akshaya as flautist at National Youth Festival, use of dialogue in songs, and being invited to play for two films.
optional_source.limit: Current body omits name. Companion report identifies Chaurasia as2009Samman recipient, strongly supporting identity but explicit interview attribution still preferable. Do not use believed composer-debut as established first.

held_gaps: No direct Akshaya/Sikandar recording credit independently established in this bounded pass; do not imply joint sessions merely from era.
Prafulla Kar is a separate composer, not proven co-composer here. Existing remembrance may support peer relationship, not invented song credit.
No portrait researched because root owns media.
No complete book read or recording listening performed.
Kau Dhana Khaila is not automatically an Akshaya/Trupti duet; prior packet attributes classic Sautuni to S.Janaki/Tansen Singh with conflicting lyricist metadata.
writing_guidance: Use three grounded bridges: Maa singer to Malajanha composer/producer; Jajabara as a set of different credited voices; Ghalib/books/radio as a life beyond film.
Keep all Sahapedia article-derived material under200words total, including footnotes; same separate200-word cap for Devdas interview.
No lyric quotations needed. Song titles only.
